'''Kathana''' is an [[Ebou Dar]]i woman and owner of the [[Yearly Brawl]] Inn. She is recently married to [[Jame]]. 
==Activities==
When [[Mat]] visits the inn, she doesn't believe his tale of how he lost an eye and tells him he should wear a hat as it would go well with his eyepatch. After talking to him for a couple of minutes, she realises that he is the man that all the soldiers in Ebou Dar are looking for.
==Background==
Jame and Kathana are named for James and Jennifer Liang, two high-profile moderators at [http://dragonmount.com Dragonmount.com] and coordinators of [[JordanCon]].
